title: Apartment, The Barrington, Ballsbridge, Dublin 4
description: No 12 is a high-end rental offering superior comfort, premium finishes, and exclusive building amenities that go far beyond standard developments. Located in The Barrington on the 2nd floor this is a luxury unfurnished spacious 2 double bedroom apt. The premier bedroom is ensuite with a walk in shower and bath, good sized walk in wardrobe. The spacious balcony overlooks the sunny forecourt and is accessible from the bedrooms. There is a second bathroom off the entrance hall. Spacious utility room with washing machine & separate dryer. There is a very generous sized living space with folding doors to a winter garden sunny aspect, ideal for reading the newspaper or as a work space. Fully fitted modern white kitchen with no extras I.e cutlery or plates. There is one parking space and lock up for storage. Ballsbridge is a Prime Location: Situated in central business districts, vibrant cultural hubs, or scenic areas close to fine dining and high-end shopping. Viewing is very highly recommended by the sole agents Sherry FitzGerald Lettings
